messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly Northline check-in. Hope the week treated you alright. Any blood pressure readings to share, or anything on your mind health-wise?
Yeah it was 141/88 this morning. Been trying harder with food lately. Saw something about cutting white bread but I don't know what to eat instead. Any ideas?

Got that reading logged, thank you. On the bread question — nutrition and diet advice is one of the things I'm not set up to help with, so I'd steer clear of guessing on that. A dietitian or your care team would really be the right call there. How are you feeling otherwise — any dizziness, headaches, anything like that?
No nothing like that. Just trying to do right by it since my doc mentioned watching the carbs at my last visit.
That's good to hear — no symptoms. Sounds like you're paying attention, which matters. I'll put your next check-in on the calendar for next week. Take care of yourself out there.

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
